messages:
Alex Chen: Quick sync — onboarding stratus-13b-v2. weights are uploaded to s3://rw-models/stratus/13b/v2/shard-{000..015}.pt. Need checksum and tokenizer quirk check before catalog submit.
Mira Patel: Got the path, sending sha256 now.
Alex Chen: sha256 for bundle: ae3f4b9d2c1e5f8b7a9c0d3e4f11223344556677889900aabbccddeeff0011223
Mira Patel: checksum matches. One tokenizer note: newline tokenization maps to <nl> in our tokenizer which breaks our sentinel prompts in chat mode.
Jordan Lee: That's the same issue we saw with halcyon. Suggest adding a post-tokenize sanitizer that maps \n -> \n (literal) or use escape sequence.
Priya Rao: For safety can we enable prefix cache bypass for canary? We don't want cached prefixes masking regressions.
Alex Chen: Agreed. Plan: pin catalog entry to version 'v2' and deploy 5% canary in us-west1, 2% in eu-west1. Fallback to stratus-6b-quant if latency >300ms or error rate >1%.
Samir Gomez: I'll create rollout policy. Need the catalog json snippet to validate lint.
Alex Chen: Paste below:
```json
{
  "model_id": "stratus-13b",
  "version": "v2",
  "weights_uri": "s3://rw-models/stratus/13b/v2/",
  "tokenizer": { "name": "stratus-tokenizer-v1", "post_sanitize": "escape_newlines" },
  "canary": { "traffic_pct": {"us-west1": 5, "eu-west1": 2}, "fallback": "stratus-6b-quant" },
  "autoscale": { "enabled": false }
}
```
Mira Patel: Lint passes locally but CI linter flags missing quant profile. Jordan can you add quant_profile: "fp16-q4"?
Jordan Lee: Added in my branch. Also proposing a quick smoke test set: small prompt set + long-context to exercise kvcache.
Priya Rao: QA will run smoke tests today. I'll post results here.
deploy-bot: Canary job scheduled for 1992003600, targets: us-west1(5%), eu-west1(2%).
Samir Gomez: I'll monitor metrics: p50/p95 latency, error rate, token cost. Ping me if fallback fires. :thumbsup:
Alex Chen: Thanks all — leaving pinned config in the PR. If no objections by EOD we'll roll the probe.
Priya Rao: No objections from QA. Proceed when CI is green.
deploy-bot: Canary started at 1992003620
Alex Chen: Closing the loop — will open a followup thread for rollout escalation policy if fallback triggers.
